title: Epic: Multi-repo branch management view
description: Replace the current minimal project view with a comprehensive branch management view for multi-repo projects. The view should show all branches per repo with change indicators (dirty, ahead/behind), allow checkout/creation of branches, and support creating merge requests via glab/gh CLI.

title: Add per-repo branch listing to project data model
description:
Extend the project package to fetch and expose branch lists per repo.

**What to do:**
- Add a `Branches []git.BranchInfo` field to `project.RepoStatus`
- In `Project.Status()`, populate branches for each repo using existing `git.GetRepoInfo()` (which already loads branches)
- Expose the current branch and ahead/behind counts per branch

**Files to modify:**
- `internal/project/project.go` — add Branches to RepoStatus, populate in Status()

**Acceptance criteria:**
- `ProjectStatus.Repos[i].Branches` contains all local branches with ahead/behind info
- Existing project view still works (backward compatible)

title: Build multi-repo branch tree UI component
description:
Create the main branch listing UI that shows repos as expandable tree nodes with their branches underneath.

**What to do:**
- Create a new view or heavily refactor `views/project.go` to show a tree: repo → branches
- Each repo row shows: repo name, current branch, dirty indicator (●)
- Each branch row shows: branch name, ahead/behind arrows (↑2 ↓1), active indicator (*)
- Use j/k for navigation, enter to expand/collapse repos
- Highlight the current branch per repo

**Files to modify:**
- `internal/app/views/project.go` — refactor to tree-based branch listing

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Repos display as collapsible groups with branches listed under each
- Current branch is visually distinct (highlighted or marked with *)
- Dirty repos show ● indicator
- Branches with unpushed/unpulled changes show ↑N ↓M counts

title: Add branch checkout across repos
description:
Allow checking out an existing branch or creating+checking out a new branch across selected repos.

**What to do:**
- Add 'c' keybinding: checkout the branch under cursor in that repo
- Add 'n' keybinding: open text input to create+checkout a new branch across all repos (or selected repos)
- Run `git checkout <branch>` or `git checkout -b <branch>` via the existing git package
- Show success/failure per repo in a results flash message
- Add git.Checkout() and git.CreateBranch() functions if they don't exist

**Files to modify:**
- `internal/git/branch.go` — add Checkout/CreateBranch functions
- `internal/app/views/project.go` — add keybindings and input handling

**Acceptance criteria:**
- 'c' checks out the highlighted branch in the highlighted repo
- 'n' prompts for branch name and creates it across all repos from their default branches
- Success/error feedback shown per repo

title: Add merge request creation via glab/gh CLI
description:
Add the ability to create merge requests / pull requests for repos from the branch view using glab (GitLab) or gh (GitHub) CLI tools.

**What to do:**
- Add 'm' keybinding: create MR/PR for the current branch in the highlighted repo
- Auto-detect whether to use `glab` or `gh` based on the remote URL (gitlab vs github)
- Run `glab mr create --fill --yes` or `gh pr create --fill` in the repo's directory
- Show a confirmation prompt before creating
- Display result (MR URL or error) in a flash message
- Add a helper in the git package: `DetectRemoteProvider(repoPath) ("gitlab"|"github"|"unknown")`

**Files to modify:**
- `internal/git/remote.go` (new) — DetectRemoteProvider, CreateMergeRequest helper
- `internal/app/views/project.go` — add 'm' keybinding and confirmation modal

**Acceptance criteria:**
- 'm' on a non-default branch triggers MR/PR creation for that repo
- Correct CLI tool (glab/gh) is auto-detected from remote
- User sees confirmation before creation
- MR URL shown on success, error shown on failure

title: Add branch status icons and visual polish
description:
Add clear visual indicators for branch states to make the view scannable at a glance.

**What to do:**
- Add icons/indicators: ● dirty worktree, ↑N ahead, ↓M behind, ✓ clean, ✗ error, ⚡ current branch
- Add color coding: green for clean, yellow for dirty, red for error, cyan for current
- Show repo-level summary line (e.g. '3 branches, 1 dirty')
- Add a legend in the help bar showing what icons mean

**Files to modify:**
- `internal/app/views/project.go` — rendering/styling updates

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Each branch line has appropriate status icons
- Colors follow the existing theme system
- Help bar shows icon legend

title: Wire up project branch view to router with F-key
description:
Ensure the new branch view is properly integrated into the project router and accessible via navigation.

**What to do:**
- The project router currently only has a single 'Project' view — keep it as the landing view
- Add the enhanced branch functionality directly into the existing project view (no separate view needed)
- Ensure Tab/F-key navigation works (currently only one view in project mode)
- Ensure the status bar shows relevant info (project name, selected repo)
- Ensure 'r' refresh reloads all branch data

**Files to modify:**
- `internal/app/app.go` — verify project router setup
- `internal/app/layout.go` — verify status bar works for project mode

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Project view loads with full branch data on startup
- Refresh ('r') reloads all repos and branches
- Status bar shows project name and selected repo info
